integration_policy: Do not connect Spanish content to the Telegram bot or Learning Space until the complete Spanish program is finished and approved. Existing English content must remain unchanged.
usage_policy: Store links and original learning notes only; do not copy full transcripts, audio, video, screenshots, or third-party worksheets into the repository.
Open videos and podcasts on their original platforms or use an officially provided embed where permitted.
Before using paid third-party material inside a paid school product, confirm the license covers commercial teaching use and embedding or linking.
Create The Teachers School comprehension exercises independently; do not reproduce the provider's worksheets.

exercise_framework.task: Choose the best summary of the clip or recording.
Answer two or three questions about clearly audible facts.
Match or choose meanings of 4–6 words heard in context.
Notice one A1 structure or useful phrase from the material.
Identify one regional word, social convention, food, place, or cultural detail without generalizing it to everyone.

audio_collection.title: Podcasts in Spanish — Level 1
audio_collection.format: Short audio episodes, usually around 1.5–4 minutes
audio_collection.access: Audio free; transcripts, worksheets and vocabulary tasks require membership
audio_collection.caution: Level 1 is labelled elementary/pre-intermediate, not strictly CEFR A1. Check the transcript and audio of each chosen episode before assigning it to A1 learners.

extra_audio.title: Copycat Cafe — Spanish Audio Course (Spain)
extra_audio.format: Five A1 episodes, 10–11 minutes, MP3 and transcript
extra_audio.caveat: Voices are AI-generated and characters are fictional. Use for repetition and pronunciation practice, not as a model of natural spontaneous speech.

excluded_paid_resources.title: Spanish Sitcom — A1
excluded_paid_resources.reason: Исключено по правилу проекта: платный продукт, не использовать и не предлагать к покупке.

youtube_library.title: VideoEle — vídeos A1
youtube_library.access: Бесплатные видео на YouTube; на сайте доступны транскрипты и методические материалы для личного использования.
youtube_library.dialect: Основная версия — Испания; у части роликов есть отдельная Latino-версия. Latino не следует автоматически маркировать как мексиканский.
youtube_library.license: Creative Commons BY-NC-ND 4.0 для материалов VideoEle: не копировать и не перерабатывать сами видео; использовать оригинальную ссылку/разрешенный embed. Коммерческое использование и включение в платный продукт требует отдельной проверки условий.

candidates.fit: Дом и повседневные действия; может быть дополнительным контекстом, не полное совпадение с распорядком дня.

candidates.title: Medios de transporte
candidates.fit: Транспорт, ir/volver/llevar; точное совпадение с темой.

candidates.title: ¡Buen fin de semana!
candidates.fit: Досуг и выражения частотности; точное тематическое совпадение.
